name: NYC Parks Drinking Fountains
description:
This dataset lists drinking fountains located in New York City parks, with 3,849 sampled records and 12 fields. Each row describes a fountain's type, location (including position and borough), paint status, associated property name and ID, parent ID, managing department, a short description, and a feature status field. Identifiers such as gispropnum and parentid link fountains to specific parks or properties.

The data can be used to map fountain locations across boroughs, compare fountain types and conditions, assess maintenance needs such as repainting or status changes, and support park visitors or planners looking for drinking water access. It is also useful for analyses of park amenities by property or department.
